{{Quote|Since the Empire has redirected the clone trooper program to other pursuits and stepped up recruiting inferior humans from the Outer Rim, the operational effectiveness of this army has declined significantly.|Commander Cody, regarding his hatred of enlisted troopers|<ref name="Databank" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''enlisted stormtrooper''' served in the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|special forces]] as an [[Stormtrooper/Legends|elite soldier]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. By [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], he was part of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial garrison]] in [[Timira City]], a [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] facility located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. His superior officer was [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]], a veteran of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and a former [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who deeply resented non-clone enlisted [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]].

==History==
{{Quote|First day on Kamino and I'm already swimming in my armor.|Unidentified stormtrooper|<ref name="Databank" />}}
The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was stationed on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] after enlisting as a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] was assigned to [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody's]] [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]]. As a major source of the [[clone stormtrooper]]s who were created to serve the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], a large [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial garrison]] was established on Kamino in order to protect the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] vital [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] facilities. This enlisted [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] was stationed on the [[Timira City]] [[Timira City Cloning Facility|Cloning Facility]] where his main activities consisted of guard and patrol duties.<ref name="Databank" />

When the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] dispatched a [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Warship/Legends|warships]] to assault Kamino in a surprise attack, the enlisted trooper and his comrades were ultimately unable to repel the invasion. The [[Assault on Kamino]] became a major early triumph for the fledgling [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]] in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]; the Imperial casualties were heavy, Timira City was destroyed, and the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] was taken [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]], who was assisted by a [[Subject 1138|rogue clone]] of the [[Death/Legends|late]] [[Galen Marek]].<ref name="Novel">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'' novelization]]</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|As if the troop morale wasn't low enough already, this place is making all of us crazy.|Unidentified stormtrooper|<ref name="Databank" />}}
This enlisted stormtrooper regarded Timira City as a miserable detail to be assigned to. Given the rarity of an attack on a major Imperial military installation site and the planet's constant rainstorms, the trooper dismissed Kamino as an inhospitable location, if not a boring one as well. Forced to frequently patrol Timira City on Commander Cody's orders, the trooper developed a particular loathing for Kamino's rainy climate. His lack of enthusiasm with the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoans]]' [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] reflected the general attitude of other Imperial soldiers and the low troop morale that they experienced.<ref name="Databank" />

==Behind the scenes==
The unidentified enlisted stormtrooper was first referenced in the databank of the [[2010]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''. His personal thoughts on his assignment in Timira City can be found in the "Timira City Cloning Facility" profile.<ref name="Databank" />
